name: AISHELL-3: Multi-Speaker Mandarin TTS Corpus
description: AISHELL-3 is a large-scale, multi-speaker Mandarin Chinese speech synthesis corpus designed for neural text-to-speech and voice conversion. It contains roughly 85 hours of high-fidelity 44.1kHz speech recordings totaling 88,035 utterances produced by 218 native Mandarin speakers across varied geographic accents, annotated with pinyin, tone marks, and character transcriptions.
